svg.title: The Roll of the Bark
svg.desc: The Roll of the Bark on the Knot temple wall: a tall panel smoothed into the bark, the title cut across its head, and under it a carved line for each person lost this year, a name and one habit. Two lines are cut; ten more are ruled and waiting. Lichen has started in the oldest letters and a lantern stands at the foot.
